title: Through Object Out
description: Through object out leaves the subject by traveling out through an object into a wider world, interior becoming exterior. The viewpoint can abandon the person and let the decisive event happen off its direct attention.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Leave through a thing. Endings, a mind opening onto a city, a room that becomes a street by way of a window, a pupil, a barred frame: absence can be the dramatic center.
The effect is the viewpoint abandoning the person, not merely passing an obstacle. A zoom out that never enters matter is not this shot.
The object must occupy the frame as a tunnel.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Stage room, object, and exterior as one spatial problem. Removable barrier, support transfer, or composite.

Choreograph exterior action and offscreen sound to carry the event if the camera looks away. Prompt: Through-object-out from [Subject], the camera exiting via an object into a wider world, the interior becoming exterior.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: The Passenger's late hotel-room shot moves toward and beyond a barred window, then looks back. Contact and The Tree of Life use exits of scale and matter as revelation.
Grammar: leave through a thing, interior becoming exterior.

sections.title: Prompt it

blocks.text: Start on the subject, name the object, arrive larger. Still: Through-object-out from [Subject], the camera exiting via an object into a wider world, the interior becoming exterior.
Video: The camera leaves [Subject] by traveling out through an object into a larger space. The object must be a tunnel.

Begin inside a quiet hotel room with a traveler seated near the edge of frame. Slowly approach a barred window, pass beyond it without visible interruption, drift into the courtyard, then turn to look back at the room. The traveler remains offscreen during a muffled disturbance. Use a planned barrier-removal composite, not bending metal.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a zoom out or a crane-up. The tell: the world enlarges but no object ever fills the frame as a passage.
The fix: occupy the lens with the object, travel through it, then the wider world.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Through Object Out in film?
Through object out is a moving viewpoint that leaves a subject by traveling out through an object into a larger space, interior becoming exterior.
Through Object Out vs Through Object In
Through-object-in enters via a prop and arrives on the person. Through-object-out exits via a prop and can abandon the person to a wider world.
When should I use Through Object Out?
Use it for endings and scale reveals that leave through a thing. Do not use a plain pull-out with no portal.
How do I prompt Through Object Out for AI image or video?
Start on the subject, travel out through a named object, arrive in a larger space. Example: Through-object-out from [Subject], the camera exiting via an object into a wider world.
